notes: Clones evolved 500 generations in different stresses; growth_protocol says all clones were grown for RNA in M9 glucose + 0.3 M NaCl (osmotic stress medium), so treatment hyperosmotic/adapted for all. Phase from 'mid-log phase (OD600 approx. 0.8)' (phase word wins). G500 (evolved in plain minimal medium, the study's control environment) taken as is_control; it is still an evolved isolate grown in osmotic medium. Mutations of the clones not given: perturbed_genes and global_regulator_perturbed left out. Temperature, aeration, rRNA removal not stated.
